verification_attempts.purpose: Read the brand site printed on the user supplied hangtag and locate an actual US product page; no product URL guessed.

required_before_activation: Verify a real US product source and USD pricing for the pictured model, color and womens S variant.
Implement and validate support for that source; the current collector and catalog search are Arc'teryx-specific.
Import only a verified online variant and validate inventory confirmation and alert delivery on the actual monitoring computer.
notes: Do not substitute mens XL / XXL, a different color, or a different Helium variant.
Do not expand SNOWBAN into a presumed full color name without a verified source.
The visible barcode and model code are lookup evidence, not verified online variant SKUs.
The label amount is not a budget, live USD offer or historical price observation.
No executable watch was added and no existing watch was changed.
